Most projects here total $2,000 to $4,500, and a 1,200 sq ft main floor with a staircase generally runs $5,500 to $8,500. The biggest variable is carpet grade, which you pick from the samples spread out in your own rooms.

It does — condos in the Bowl, ramblers up in Seaview or Firdale, anywhere in town. Then we measure every room and stair and write your price before leaving. The visit is free.
How much is carpet stretching in Edmonds?

Stretching starts at $99 per room in Edmonds. If the pile still stands up and the color still suits the room, power-stretching pulls out ripples, waves and the bunching at doorways for about a fifth of what replacement costs — which makes it the right first question before you spend on new carpet.
What do carpeted stairs cost in Edmonds?

Stair carpet starts at $18 per step, in either a waterfall wrap or a tailored cap-and-band. Pie-shaped turns and landings — common in Edmonds split-entries and view homes with stacked floors — are measured and written into the quote from the start, so nothing appears later as a surprise line item.
How long does a carpet install take in Edmonds?

One day covers most Edmonds homes. A few bedrooms plus a staircase is a comfortable single day for the crew, while a fully furnished multi-level house can stretch into a second. Your written quote states the schedule, and condo buildings with elevator reservations or posted work hours get planned around in advance.
Is furniture moving included in the installation?

Yes — beds, couches, dressers and tables are moved and returned on most jobs at no separate charge. We ask you to handle the light stuff first: closet floors, lamps, electronics, plants and anything fragile or personal you'd rather move with your own hands.
Should I restretch my carpet or replace it?

Restretch when the pile stands up, the backing is sound and the color still works — that is a $99-per-room repair instead of a whole new floor. Replace when traffic lanes are crushed flat, seams are opening, the backing is breaking down, or pet odor has outlived a professional cleaning. We identify which situation you have before quoting anything.

What carpet holds up best with pets?

Solution-dyed nylon with a sealed backing, installed over a moisture-barrier pad. The dye runs through the fiber, so it can be scrubbed hard — even with diluted bleach — without fading, and the sealed backing plus barrier pad keep accidents from soaking into the subfloor, where odor becomes permanent. The barrier pad upgrade starts at $0.65 per square foot.
What warranty covers my carpet installation?

Two layers. OC Flooring backs the workmanship with a 1-year warranty on the installation itself, and the mill warranties the carpet — typically 10 to 25 years on wear and stain, depending on the grade. Both appear in writing on your quote. Note that the pad you pick can affect the mill's coverage, one reason all three pad grades come along on the visit.
